name: Lam Chanye
source:
Mysterious girl who appeared at the door of Chotung's Cafe on Halloween night. She claims to have no magic, but people recover very quickly under her care. She has a sunshine personality.

[spoiler]Her name in the original world was Kagari (伽雅理).[/spoiler]

Note: Despite the same last name Lam, she is not related to Chotung.
